# Byte

> Byte is a curated talent fellowship that brings eight outstanding young individuals from Finland to San Francisco for one week of focused conversations with world-class founders and operators building the future with technology.

Byte selects eight highly driven, ambitious individuals under 25 who are Finnish citizens or permanent residents. Participants are chosen for their technical ability, drive, and ambition — not prior experience. The format is intentionally small so every meeting is personal and high-signal for both sides.

Byte 3 takes place in autumn 2026. Applications are open 7–21 September 2026. The week in San Francisco runs 26 October – 1 November 2026. All expenses covered.

Participation is free. Travel and accommodation are covered by the Technology Industries of Finland Centennial Foundation (Teknologiateollisuuden 100-vuotissäätiö).

Contact: guidebyte@gmail.com
